Refining throughput is expected to rise 10% Q/Q, enabling the company to capture historically high refining margins in Europe and worldwide. Oil trading is expected to maintain its strong performance, while marketing and services is also projected to remain strong.
Integrated LNG results are expected to rise sharply, supported by a 20% Q/Q increase in average LNG prices and stronger gas and LNG trading amid the prolonged conflict in the Strait of Hormuz.

expects Q3 hydrocarbon production of 2.45M-2.50M barrels of oil equivalent per day. Excluding the impact of the Middle East conflict, production is expected to grow more than 4% Y/Y, above the company's annual growth guidance of 3%.
The company is scheduled to report its Q3 results on October 29.
